ornob.archivevol.001 — for farhin

a small gift, from someone who can’t say it properly

Farhin

This is you.

Made of a thousand tiny lights, drifting like they can’t decide where to rest. Now touch her face.

And this is what you do to me.

Everything you touch, blooms.

ch. 01 — the letter

Farhin,

I’m not good with words. You know that. When it matters most, my mouth goes quiet and my head gets loud, so I do the only thing I’ve ever really been good at: I build. This is me trying to talk to you.

I know I’m clumsy. I know I disappear without telling you, and I know how that must feel on your side of the screen. But even in the quiet, I notice you: the way you smile, the way you look, the way you make an ordinary photo feel like something worth keeping.

And still, somehow, you stayed. I think about that more than I ever say it. You stayed through the silences, through the clumsiness, through every time I didn’t know what to say. I don’t know what I did to deserve that, but I’m grateful for it every single day.

I can’t impress you with perfect words. So this is what I have: a little sky made of small lights, and every one of them is a way of saying thank you.

ch. 02 — the honest list

things I’m bad at

  • talking properly, when it matters
  • telling you before I go quiet
  • impressing you with the right words
  • being less clumsy

things I’m not

  • gone. I always come back
  • careless about you
  • ungrateful, even when I’m silent
  • going anywhere

I’m bad at saying it. I’m not bad at meaning it.

ch. 05 — what I promise

Small promises. Real ones.

  • II’ll try to tell you before I go quiet.
  • III’ll say thank you out loud, not just in my head.
  • IIII’ll keep coming back, every time.
  • IVI’ll always be here.
ch. 06 — a garden for you

Plant something. Watch it bloom.

Tap anywhere in the dark. Every flower is a small attempt to match how beautiful you are. Plant seven and see what grows.

tap the soil · 0 / 7
That’s seven. Still not as beautiful as you.

So this is the sky I built for you.

Thank you for staying in the quiet.
And you are so beautiful.

I’ll always be here.

From, Ornob
